# snipeit_model (Resource)

Manages an asset model in Snipe-IT. Assets reference a model, which in turn defines category, manufacturer and custom fieldset.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `category_id` (Number) Id of the category of this model (must be an `asset` category).
- `name` (String) Name of the model.

### Optional

- `eol` (Number) End-of-life in months.
- `fieldset_id` (Number) Id of the custom fieldset attached to this model.
- `manufacturer_id` (Number) Id of the manufacturer of this model.
- `min_amt` (Number) Minimum quantity before a low-stock alert triggers.
- `model_number` (String) Manufacturer model number.
- `notes` (String) Free-form notes.
- `requestable` (Boolean) Whether assets of this model can be requested by users.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Numeric id of the model.
